kurz: Oxygen, light and heat break fats down over time into unpleasant-smelling substances.
bild_im_kopf: Like rust on metal, only with fat.
was_passiert: Unsaturated fats, as found in nuts, wholemeal flour and many oils, react slowly with oxygen. Light and heat speed this up. Substances form that smell of paint or cardboard.
warum_wichtig: Explains why nuts, wholemeal flour and linseed oil should be stored somewhere cool and dark.
faustregeln: Buy nuts and wholemeal flour in moderation, or freeze them.
Go by smell rather than by date.
